notes: Sourced from Merging Technologies' official Technical Sheet PDF (merging.com), cross-checked against the manufacturer product page (now redirecting to Neumann, which acquired Merging) and the SoundOnSound review. Rear panel: Mic/Line In 1-2 are combo XLR/TRS jacks; Main Out 1-2 are XLR; Line Out 3-4 are TRS; GPI/MIDI and GPO/MIDI are 1/4" TRS; two RJ45 network ports (locking EtherCON-compatible) carry RAVENNA/AES67 (Gigabit Ethernet, 256x256 ch) and/or Dante Ready (64x64 ch, license required) plus PoE+. Front panel: Inst/Hi-Z/Line In 3-4 are combo TRS jacks; two independent 1/4" TRS stereo headphone outputs. Power connector is a locking DC barrel jack (2.5mm ID/5.5mm OD); unit can alternatively be powered via PoE+ over either network port (not modeled as a separate port here since it shares the RJ45 jacks). No USB, SDI, HDMI, or word-clock BNC connector is present on this model — Anubis is purely AoIP-networked for digital audio transport. Two hardware variants exist (Pro and Premium, differing only in supported sample rates/DSD - not physical I/O); the "SPS" suffix in some listings refers to an internal power supply option, not a connector change. Talkback mic is built-in (no external connector).
